# op_vault (Resource)

Manages a 1Password vault.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `title` (String) Vault title.

### Optional

- `allow_admins_access` (Boolean) Grant administrators access to this vault. Only settable at creation.
- `description` (String) Vault description.

### Read-Only

- `active_item_count` (Number) Number of active items in the vault.
- `attribute_version` (Number) Vault attribute version, incremented on presentation changes.
- `content_version` (Number) Vault content version, incremented on item changes.
- `id` (String) Vault ID.
- `vault_type` (String) Vault type, e.g. `personal`.
